SELECT
ct.cart_id, ct.user_id AS customer_id, ct.product_id, ct.quantity,
cu.user_name AS customer_name, cu.user_email AS customer_email, cu.user_phone AS customer_phone, cu.wallet_balance,
p.product_name, p.brand, p.product_description, p.product_price, p.product_status,
c.category_id, c.category_name, c.category_description,
s.user_id AS seller_id, s.user_name AS seller_name, s.user_email AS seller_email, s.user_phone AS seller_phone, s.shop_name, s.shop_address
FROM cart ct
INNER JOIN customers cu ON ct.user_id = cu.user_id
INNER JOIN products p ON ct.product_id = p.product_id
INNER JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id
LEFT JOIN sellers s ON p.user_id = s.user_id
WHERE ct.cart_id = #{cartId}
